name: Notes on the Wyrm
description: A naturalist's field notes, several pages scorched at the edges.
paragraphs: The wyrm does not breathe fire so much as exhale it -- a byproduct of whatever burns in its gut, not a weapon it aims with any real precision. Stand to the side of a wyrm, not in front of it, and you have already improved your odds considerably.
Its hide is thickest along the back and near-useless as armor along the belly. This is, I am told, why wyrm hunters spend so much of their careers lying on their backs.
I did not finish these notes in the field. I finished them afterward, from memory, because I no longer have the notebook I started with. Or the leg I was standing on when I started it.
